<thought>Using the three measured resistances between the nodes N_b1‑X1 (5 Ω), N_b1‑X2 (13.333 Ω) and X1‑X2 (18.333 Ω) the only topology that fits all three measurements is a delta (triangle) network connecting the three nodes. Solving the delta‑to‑equivalent‑resistance equations gives the individual resistor values:
- R1 (between X1 and X2) ≈ 28.36 Ω
- R2 (between X2 and N_b1) ≈ 17.96 Ω
- R3 (between N_b1 and X1) ≈ 5.53 Ω  

These three resistors satisfy the measured pairwise resistances (within rounding) and constitute the complete subnetwork 2.

The required JSON description lists the resistor values and their connections.
